item.title: 🥁 The bands are back! The 44th annual Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza is coming to…
item.description:
🥁 The bands are back! The 44th annual Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza is coming to the new Glaspie Field at Martin High School! All six Arlington ISD high school marching bands will take the field, plus a special performance from UTA’s marching band.
📆 Monday, Sept. 28 ⌚ 7 p.m. 📍 Glaspie Field at Martin High School 🎟️ FREE admission 🥫 Arlington ISD Fine Arts will also host a canned food drive benefiting Mission Arlington, so bring a few cans and help support our community.
Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza set for Sept. 28:https://bit.ly/4xWO6Lh
